ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: There are two main components in the figure, and there are curved arrows; the problem asks to ignore the arrows. There is an organic component at the bottom: the central carbon is connected to R1 and R2, and forms a double bond with N; N is further connected to O; O is also connected to H. At the top there is a phosphorus-chlorine-containing component: it is labeled PCl4, and P is connected to an explicitly drawn Cl. Reasoning: according to the specified method, first divide into two components and count. In the lower organic component, count only non-hydrogen bonds: C-R1, C-R2, C=N, N-O, for a total of 4; O-H involves hydrogen, so exclude it. In the upper component, the explicitly drawn P-Cl bond is 1, and PCl4 represents another 4 P-Cl bonds, for a total of 5. The total is 4 + 5 = 9.
